indicator.name: Households connected to main-grid electricity
indicator.description: Share of households connected to electricity on the main grid in the 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey.
indicator.expected_source: KNBS 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey — Housing Characteristics, Amenities and Adequacy
indicator.expected_availability_note: Published for all 47 counties. This governed profile slot reuses the canonical P05/P19 main-grid electricity series; no parent value is inherited.
